title: rosa pomifera var. engadinensis
intro: Rosa pomifera var. engadinensis, commonly known as Alpine Rose or Engadin Rose, is a plant species within the Rosa genus. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties that may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Rosa pomifera var. engadinensis include soothing and calming effects, which may be beneficial in treating anxiety and promoting relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
